notes: Use the attack direction captured when windup begins; do not change authored rows in the middle of the action.
Frames 0 and 1 are anticipation, frames 2 and 3 are airborne, frame 4 is the landing impact, and frame 5 is recovery.
The vertical jump is authored inside the frames. Never add a second render-only Y jump or change collision height.
Keep the world-space ground anchor and attack direction fixed while the action sheet plays.
The sprite contains no shadow, impact ring, leaves, dust, damage number, HP bar or hit flash; keep those game-rendered.
Damage and impact effects must occur once when attack frame 4 begins, not when the windup ends.
